focusThemeSet.brief: Promote focus, comfortable at any ambient brightness
principles: never pure #000 (halation, worse with astigmatism) or #fff (glare)
low chroma, ONE restrained accent per theme - multiple accents are noise, noise is the enemy of focus
small surface-to-surface steps so panels do not glare, while text contrast stays high (the two are independent)
--glow-amber: none across the set - glow fights readability
body text held at 12.7-14:1 (AAA), roughly double the AA requirement
focusThemeSet.method: Palettes solved numerically BEFORE writing CSS: script computed WCAG luminance ratios and iteratively tightened --text-dim until it cleared 4.5:1 against BOTH --bg and --panel. One accent returned 4.36:1 and was darkened pre-ship.
